ratings_definition.difficulty_stars: 1 isolated local change;2 public FFI/state;3 cross-layer state/tests;4 multiwindow/framework/window-local authority;5 SPI ABI/focus/raw/DnD/paused rendering and broad validation
ratings_definition.complexity: independent state/coupling/ABI/test-matrix estimate; not calendar duration
ratings_definition.api_support: public app-side API is not universal cross-process goal guarantee; SPI availability is not public stability

features.name: NSEvent构造/roundtrip
features.completion_judgment: windowNumber/base坐标、uptime、bridge null与字段读回；容易补构造层，不单独交付真后台

features.name: PID/window click与key
features.api_support: 公开CGEvent PID post＋部分SPI stamping
features.scope: 应用普通事件，不含全局hotkey/raw game
features.completion_judgment: 接收窗口/firstResponder、flags/timestamp及goal读回；void post不算消费ACK

features.name: SkyLight候选transport
features.completion_judgment: dlsym/null、private auth、no-raise恢复、一次派发及错误隔离；可受控实现，不全量默认替换

features.name: 完整drag/source状态
features.completion_judgment: down/dragged/up、Quartz配对eventNumber/pressure/delta、source lifetime、release-only；优先补并禁止重发down

features.name: typed move/hover/tooltip
features.api_support: 公开app-side tracking；非通用跨进程效果保证
features.completion_judgment: active策略、nested loop、global poll、dwell/readback；应原创实现，不伪造tracking指针/把overlay当hover

features.name: relative/raw游戏兼容
features.api_support: 公开client raw API，无通用定向raw保证

features.name: key-focus接收与恢复
features.api_support: 公开状态＋SPI focus，frontmost PID不足
features.scope: 用户前台输入不受干扰及目标AppKit key状态
features.completion_judgment: 记录key recipient、physical-input连续性、restore；CPS panel与normal window不同

features.name: covered/offscreen capture
features.completion_judgment: non-on-screen枚举、SC status/dirty/scale/stride；RWI枚举与input mapping缺口应补

features.name: window-local authority
features.scope: 输入不依赖window完整落入一个display

features.name: minimized/hidden目标
features.api_support: minimized SCK pause已说明，renderer策略app依赖
features.scope: 语义动作与fresh pixels分别报告
features.completion_judgment: paused/stale不可作fresh proof，不能自动unhide伪装后台；semantic-only/合作app另定义

features.name: AX语义/hover-like动作
features.completion_judgment: Press/ShowAlternateUI/SetValue不是pointer；可能no-op须goal读回，优先补且不连带禁其他route

features.name: 多window/popup Live
features.scope: 授权归属图，不是单PID硬门禁
features.completion_judgment: single-window不带child/popup，OS dialog可不同PID；补聚合/重发现，不扩大secure-session授权

features.name: 跨window/app原生DnD
features.api_support: 公开app-side session/pasteboard，不保证任意注入
features.completion_judgment: MIME/destination/capture/enter/move/leave/drop与多资源scope；独立长阶段先自有fixture，未提供不等于不能做

features.name: browser内容独立route
features.api_support: 公开browser协议，不是任意Mac input API
features.completion_judgment: context lifecycle、buttons/dragover/incognito；可显式整合，native route保留，不静默global fallback

features.name: hook/runloop/取消恢复
features.api_support: 公开tap/runloop，权限和模式仍有约束
features.completion_judgment: common modes、callback retain、disabled/wake、cancel/up清理；迁移状态机而非global干扰

features.name: capture性能/画质/Live
features.completion_judgment: bytesPerRow、dirty/contentRect/scale、fresh status/source调度；可做性能工程，不凭语言/上游benchmark推快

decision: Rust原生、多route、按动作/窗口状态报告能力；NSEvent工厂为优先候选之一，SkyLight显式SPI候选比较；不等待完美开源库，也不凭库缺口宣判不可能。
first_implementation_gate: offline constructor/roundtrip/source-state and protocol-capability tests before allocated GUI recorder
non_goals: no unreviewed install script or third-party runtime deployment
trycua/cua is not Codex built-in Computer Use
no Mac results extrapolated to Windows/Linux
